project_type: Python 3.12 orchestration engine (KiroCrew Flow) — hexagonal architecture over Kiro Crew; zero-token polling of issue labels crewflow:*
language: Python 3.12 (uses StrEnum, PEP 604 unions, frozenset[str] generics — MUST run with python3.12, not the default python3 which is 3.9 here)
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml; no compiled build. Install with: python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
test_framework: pytest + pytest-cov + pytest-asyncio. Tests live in flow/tests/, one file per module. Domain tests use NO mocks (hexagonal isolation is the point). Provider/deployment tests use unittest.mock.
build_command: python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'  (no separate compile step)
test_command: python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/ -q  (full CI: python3.12 -m ruff check flow/ && python3.12 -m mypy flow/ --ignore-missing-imports && python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/ --cov=flow --cov-fail-under=75)
verification_instructions: 1) python3.12 -m ruff check flow/ (must pass, zero warnings). 2) python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/ -q (all pass except the one known root-permission failure). 3) Optionally python3.12 -m mypy flow/ --ignore-missing-imports. There is NO Dockerfile; docker build is not applicable.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Mermaid PNGs in docs/diagramas/ are derived from resources/mermaid/*.mmd but are unrelated to this task and must not be regenerated.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/kirocrew-flow && python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'. Then run tests with python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/ -q.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET (pip installs work). The DEFAULT python3 is 3.9 and CANNOT run this code (SyntaxError on StrEnum/unions) — always use python3.12. One pre-existing test failure is environmental and unrelated: flow/tests/test_prompts_loader.py::TestRenderPromptFallback::test_template_corrompido_ilegivel_usa_fallback fails only because it runs as root (chmod 0o000 is ignored by root). Do NOT try to 'fix' that test; treat 569 passing as the green baseline.
contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md and .kiro/steering/fluxo.md (inclusion: always). Domain layer (flow/domain/) MUST NOT import flow.adapters, aiohttp, subprocess, socket, requests, httpx — enforced by flow/tests/test_domain_boundary.py. Use StrEnum for label enums, @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) for dataclasses. Dependencies injected as params, never fetched inside domain. ruff must stay clean (line-length 100, E501 ignored). Provider parity is enforced by flow/tests/test_provider_parity.py.
key_patterns: State model in flow/domain/state.py: State(StrEnum) with 7 states spec/ready/todo/dev/review/qa/done, each value prefixed 'crewflow:'. Modifier(StrEnum) with blocked/running/reviewed/hml-bypass/changes-requested/conflito. parse_state() raises EstadoAmbiguo if >1 state label present; parse_modifiers() ignores unknown labels. The executor (flow/executor/executor.py) is pure: decide() returns ExecutorDecision(add_labels, remove_labels) but does NO I/O. The driving adapter deployment/deployment.py applies labels via provider.set_labels(project, key, labels) which REPLACES the full label set. ROOT CAUSE: (a) the DISPATCH_DEV branch in deployment.py fires _dispatch() but NEVER calls set_labels — the todo->dev->review transitions are performed by the one-shot LLM session via gh, which only ADDS the new state label without removing the old one, so states accumulate; and (b) the label-applying branches that DO exist (rebrand, needs_human, mark_conflito) each hand-roll add/remove loops with no guarantee of state exclusivity. There is NO transition_state helper anywhere. State label values set: {s.value for s in State}. Modifiers to preserve: {m.value for m in Modifier} plus type/priority labels crewflow:feature|bug|hotfix|debt|p1|p2|p3 and any non-crewflow labels.
relevant_files: flow/domain/state.py — add transition_state() helper here (pure, no I/O); already has State, Modifier, parse_state, EstadoAmbiguo, can_transition
flow/tests/test_domain_state.py — add unit tests for transition_state (no mocks)
flow/executor/executor.py — decide()/_decide_by_state() produce add_labels/remove_labels; review DISPATCH_DEV (todo->dev), DISPATCH_REVIEWER, MARK_CONFLITO decisions for consistency

deployment/deployment.py — driving adapter; apply transition_state at set_labels call sites; the DISPATCH_DEV branch (~line 1040) currently never calls set_labels; rebrand (~1123), needs_human (~1245), mark_conflito (~1355) branches hand-roll label edits
flow/tests/test_e2e_integration.py — end-to-end executor+provider flow with a mock provider (set_labels mocked); good place for a todo->dev->review no-accumulation test
flow/prompts/dev.md — the dev one-shot prompt that instructs the agent to change labels; must instruct removing prior state atomically
README.md — 'Estados — 1 por vez, nesta ordem' section to reinforce the invariant
.kiro/steering/fluxo.md and .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md — reinforce the single-state invariant and document transition_state
directory_structure: flow/domain (pure state/gates), flow/ports (IssueProvider Protocol), flow/adapters (github_/jira_ transport+normalization+client), flow/scan (scanner+SQLite cache), flow/executor (decide()), flow/audit (state_comment), flow/prompts (MD templates + loader), flow/config (SquadConfig, workflow templates), flow/webhooks. deployment/deployment.py is the driving adapter (Kiro Crew cron). flow/tests holds the full pytest suite. squads/*.yaml and workflows/*.yaml are config. docs/ and resources/mermaid/ are documentation.
